relations.evidence: kālītatvam alekhayad vijavaraḥ śrīcakrarājaḥ ... devena saṃyatnataḥ

date.as_written: ṣaṣṭhadyogajasammite suraguror ghasre[ʼ]site pakṣake ... māse kārttikike ... pañcamyāṃ śubhayogamiśritabharaṇyāṃ tārakāyāṃ

notes: The chronogram 'ṣaṣṭha-dyo-gaja' corresponds to 6-0-8 = NS 806. The catalogue lists the scribe as 'Manohara', evidently misreading the compound 'manohararasādevena' (manohara-rasād devena) in the Śārdūlavikrīḍita verse; syntactically, Cakrarāja is the causer ('alekhayad') and Deva is the instrumental agent/scribe ('devena saṃyatnataḥ').
